job_description: Rovi is an AI-powered care concierge and virtual clinic for employer health plans. We monitor clinical data in real time, catch expensive care before it gets scheduled, and redirect members to higher-quality, lower-cost options. When someone has a condition we can treat directly, we do that through our own virtual clinic. The problem we’re solving: in-network prices for the same procedure vary up to 10x within a single zip code. A hospital MRI costs $3,000. The independent imaging center ten minutes away charges $500. Same scan, same quality. But nobody tells the patient, the doctor doesn’t know the price, and the employer won’t see the claim for months. So the expensive option wins by default, every time. Rovi changes that. We deliver high-quality care to member before they choose the expensive or low-quality default. Our AI-native clinic allows us to treat and navigate care, meaning we can reduce outpatient spend by over 30% while improving health outcomes. We’re live with 30,000 patients today and adding thousands more each month. We’re backed by Y Combinator, Lightspeed, Gradient (Google’s AI fund), Liquid 2 (Joe Montana), and others. The Role You’ll join a small team of nurse navigators at Rovi and play a defining role in how clinical navigation works here. We’re building a navigation platform that enables clinicians to coordinate and deliver care. We want you to focus on the cases that require real judgement and relationship building, and reduce the noise of administrative and booking activities. You will help us build the system that gets us there. Day-to-day, you’ll own a panel of members, manage their care across providers, and handle inbound clinical questions, all from our navigation platform. You’ll work under physician oversight for clinical decisions and escalations. You’ll also surface what we should build and what to fix to make the product better serve your and your patient’s needs.
